usage: Common noun for a large area of trees and wild land; very natural in everyday and school vocabulary.
Often used in nature, geography, travel, and environmental topics. It sounds neutral and standard.
Can appear with verbs like 去、入、保護, but keep the phrasing simple at beginner level.
Useful when talking about forests as places, habitats, or scenery; for plants and gardening topics, it usually refers to the wider natural environment.
